input.query:
SELECT
  c.id AS customer_id,
  c.name AS customer_name,
  o.id AS order_id,
  o.status AS order_status,
  o.order_date,
  p.name AS product_name,
  p.sku,
  oi.id AS order_item_id,
  oi.quantity,
  oi.unit_price_cents,
  r.id AS refund_id,
  r.status AS refund_status,
  r.reason AS refund_reason,
  r.amount_cents,
  r.requested_at,
  r.evidence_submitted
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id
WHERE c.name = 'Ava Thompson'
  AND p.name ILIKE '%Bluetooth Headphones%'
input.intent: Find Ava Thompson's order and refund details for Bluetooth Headphones

Final-Sale Exclusion

Items in a `Clearance` or `Final Sale` product category are not eligible for a refund. `Clearance` and `Final Sale` are enforced as governed values via a CHECK constraint on `products.category`, not free text.
